description: Scan the repo and write shelfready.yaml, the single source of truth for the pages. Ask the developer for country, email, brand, legal name and trader status first; don't guess them. Refuses to overwrite an existing file unless force is true.

agentsNote.description: Also add a short ShelfReady note to AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md, if the repo uses that) so coding agents run the checks before a release. Ask the developer first.

baseUrl.description: Where the pages will live, e.g. https://example.com/myapp/

brand.description: Brand or studio name shown on the pages.

country.description: Publisher country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. DE). Decides which pages are required.

email.description: Public contact email shown on the pages.

path.description: App repository folder. Default: the server's working directory.

phone.description: Second contact channel for DE/AT traders.

trader.description: EU trader status: true if the app or in-app purchases cost money.

voice.description: How pages speak: I (solo developer) or we (team).

name: init
title: Create shelfready.yaml
